speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg. To help me identify the cause, please describe exactly where the pain starts and where it travels, and on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is it?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar disc herniation. The sudden onset of sharp lower back pain radiating to the foot during exercise is highly characteristic of a disc herniation compressing a nerve root. Given the acute presentation, please refrain from heavy lifting or strenuous activity until further evaluation is complete.
